parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the name of this type of nuclear reaction.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the energy released when one nucleus of helium-4 is formed from deuterium is $3.47 \times 10^{-12}\,\text{J}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: A star has a radius of $6.96 \times 10^{8}\,\text{m}$. Helium-4 is produced in this star, from deuterium, at a mass rate of $7.34 \times 10^{11}\,\text{kg s}^{-1}$. All the energy released from this process is radiated away from the star. All the energy that is radiated from the star is released by this process.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the luminosity of the star.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(i) to determine the surface temperature of the star.

stem: The deuterium nucleus ($^{2}_{1}\text{H}$) has a mass defect of $0.002388\,\text{u}$. The helium-4 nucleus ($^{4}_{2}\text{He}$) has a mass defect of $0.030377\,\text{u}$. Helium-4 is formed from deuterium in a nuclear reaction that can be represented by the equation $$3\,^{2}_{1}\text{H} \longrightarrow ^{4}_{2}\text{He} + ^{1}_{1}\text{p} + ^{1}_{0}\text{n}.$$
